As soon as you arrive at the Eerie Ruins, Homerus senses the energy of a Neseref, an ancient Neterunian transport. Your AI can connect to the Neseref's network, enabling you to travel quickly along the Tree.

Homerus managed to connect to the Neseref network. From now on, you can connect and use any Neseref you find. 
You noticed a Malaxdon in distress, undoubtedly part of the team Yalda sent to investigate the area.
